svg.text: A probe on the option text reads the answer; during the reasoning, no readout beats the text itself
Share of runs where the readout's top option is the correct one (chance = 25%). Thinking mode; questions held out for the probes.
Runs / questions: no hint 572 / 164, told to argue for B 348 / 39, honest errors 62 / 14. Content-word rows: only the 80 / 19 / 8 questions

svg.text: share pointing to the correct option
Layer per readout: the layer that did best on held-out no-hint runs mid-reasoning (chosen on the reference group only).
The option-text probe reads the prompt's option tokens, so it has one value per item, the same at every position.
* Only questions whose options have distinctive content words. Calibrated: minus each token's mean score over the prompt tail. On the honest-error items the
model's correct runs score as low (0.18).
